subject: Request: short runway due to integration delay — ask for trial runway + credit top-up
messages:
From: Alex Wilson <alex.wilson@atlashealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline — integration slip, need runway

Hi Ben,

Quick heads-up from our SRE/Platform team: during the initial connector work with our data team we ran into a blocker with the lambda-based ingestion (credentials rotation + an unexpected rate-limit pattern). That has pushed our internal test plan out by ~2 weeks.

We were hoping to finish the pilot validation and go into the next phase before your trial credits expire. Given the delay, could Redwood extend the trial window and/or top up credits so we don't lose momentum?

I attached a short SRE log snippet that shows the error pattern. Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Wilson
Director, Platform Engineering | Atlas Health

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Wilson <alex.wilson@atlashealth.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline — integration slip, need runway

Alex — thanks for the update and for sending the log. Sorry to hear the ingestion connector ran into that rotation/rate-limit combo — I can see how that would stall validation.

We absolutely want to keep this moving. I can propose a couple options while I route approval internally:
- 30-day trial extension + 60k token top-up (fast approval)
- 60-day extension + 100k token top-up (manager sign-off)

Which of those would keep you on schedule? If you want, we can also schedule an SRE sync with our integrations lead to look at the logs — might speed up remediation.

I’ll loop in my manager to get the green light.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

Thanks Ben — the 30-day + 60k sounds like it would get us to a stable validation. If we can also get a short 30-minute SRE pairing session that week, that would be ideal.

We’re estimating we’ll need up to ~40k tokens for the remaining smoke tests and another 15–20k for validation traffic. So the 60k buffer covers it.

Please let me know next steps.

—Alex
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 08:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Request: approve 30-day extension + 60k credit for Atlas Health (DH-8241-Atlas)

Neha / Marissa —

Atlas Health (DH-8241-Atlas) hit a short integration blocker that pushed their validation out ~2 weeks. They’ve asked for a runway extension and a credit top-up. They’re asking specifically for 30 days and a 60k token top-up; they estimate ~55–60k usage to finish smoke tests + validation.

Why I’m asking: Atlas is a strategic mid-market opportunity in healthcare (PHI-sensitive workflows), we’ve run the security docs and they’re engaged on Redwood Private evaluation. Keeping momentum through validation keeps renewal/expansion probability high.

Proposed approval: 30-day trial extension + 60,000 token credit (one-time promotional credit). No change to contract terms; we record as promotional credit on HubSpot (HS-45271).

Conditions I recommend: 1) Enable SRE pairing session with our integrations lead (we’ll schedule), 2) Credit is one-time and must be used during the extension window, 3) If deployment reaches production in the next quarter, we revisit commercial terms.

Attachments: integration-runbook.pdf (short playbook for the pairing session).

Can you approve? If you’d prefer the larger 60-day/100k option, say so and I’ll note for exec sign-off.

Thanks,
Ben
